title: Research: extend conditional P112 mixed566 common cut to 35
body:
## Summary

Extend the conditional P112 shortening theorem for arbitrary residual binary support ranks 5,6,6 over every characteristic-zero field.

```diff
- ONE arbitrary common cut of at most 34 coordinates
+ ONE arbitrary common cut of at most 35 coordinates
```

This answers PR3353's explicit next question. A new full-D6 near-axis lemma handles its remaining union84 branch. The retained sharp A2 joint-incidence20 lemma closes E6. No sharpness, literal caller, full C5, supplier, kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- Before: PR3353 stops at E6 equality and insufficient D6 concentration. After: the E6 contradiction is 86>84; the D6 branch bounds are 47>46, 49>48, 50>48 and 51>48.
- The complete 97,155-five-space census finds exactly 60 nonconcentrated nine-axis closures. The 16 large rank-six sections per axis give 15,360 full-plane unions, all covering at most45 sites. A separate 35,960-four-root-basis reconstruction agrees on every closure digest. All 7,560 ordered-axis transports pass.
- Registered Python 3.12.15, optimized Python 3.15.0, five behavior/source groups with eight actual rejected CLI mutants, warning diagnostics, Ruff and formatting pass. Read-only Git-free optimized Python 3.14.8 replay passes all three scripts on the actual final publication commit. An initial test-fixture permissions failure was fixed using private writable byte copies; proof and mathematical verifier bytes stayed unchanged.
- All 17 package/input byte comparisons and source-history checks pass. Inputs are pinned to canonical main 6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c, unchanged at submission. Final commit 2698555c85412134edf525ba3f4780add4104893. No pending Git object is needed.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-mixed566-cut35
python3 -W error -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-mixed566-cut35 --check-source-history
```

The package includes the complete proof, finite results, exact sources, replay hook, controls and open next question. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3156#discussioncomment-19007975).

Inherited global capacities, concentration, four-puncture capacity, pair-union, E6 and Weyl-chamber premises remain conditional. Their historical heavy replays, selected cold replay, physical/native and all-size admission are unrun. Internal computational corroboration is separate from human or proof-kernel review.

Credit PR3353/3325/3299/3295/3324/3292, the retained sharp A2 incidence20 source and PR3278/3269/3267/3260/3262, DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, David Arias, joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112/root-simplex lineage.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

**Blast Radius:** Isolated

Only research/p112-mixed566-cut35 is added. Frozen inputs and the selected frontier are unchanged.
